name: Ashwat Kumar Singh
description: Ashwat Kumar Singh — DevOps and Platform Engineer at Amadeus Labs. Kubernetes, GitOps, observability, and open source.

projects.name: Minicontainer
projects.description: A minimal container runtime in Go implementing Linux namespaces and cgroups v2. An exploration of the isolation and resource controls underneath containers.

projects.name: Homelab Kubernetes Platform
projects.description: A self-hosted k3s cluster with ArgoCD GitOps, Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, and Traefik ingress. Personal services deployed declaratively from a Git repository.

highlights.title: GitOps & deployments
highlights.text: Implemented an ArgoCD rollout for Dev/UAT, replacing Jenkins deployment jobs with declarative manifests and cutting mean deployment time from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes.

highlights.title: Build performance
highlights.text: Halved main-repository build times from 60 to 30 minutes with Develocity Build Cache and Test Distribution, saving 200+ engineering hours per month across 30+ developers.

highlights.title: Logging modernization
highlights.text: Evaluated a migration from Logstash to Fluent Bit through a proof of concept: analyzed logs and resource metrics, tested multiple configurations, and documented findings to guide migration planning.

highlights.title: Security hardening
highlights.text: Remediated 50+ high and critical CVEs identified by Black Duck and Prisma through dependency upgrades and code fixes, bringing the backlog close to zero.

highlights.title: CI quality
highlights.text: Hardened CI across 30+ repositories with required checks, reproducible builds, and signed artifacts, standardizing release pipelines across the organization.

highlights.title: Artifactory management
highlights.text: Diagnosed an ineffective cleanup policy, tested retention parameters with JFrog CLI dry runs, and revised automated cleanup, reducing repository usage from 96% to 30%.

highlights.title: Repository migration
highlights.text: Managed the migration of 70+ repositories from Bitbucket to GitHub. Remediated live and historical secrets, preserved workflows and permissions, validated pipeline integrations, and wrote migration runbooks and onboarding documentation.

highlights.title: Prompt-Lint
highlights.text: Built a GitHub Action treating LLM prompts as code. Four layers of static and LLM analysis block secret leaks, PII, and prompt-injection patterns at pull-request time in under 30 seconds.

openSource.name: Lima VM
openSource.description: A WSL2-style Linux VM runtime. Contributed seven merged pull requests improving guest-agent networking, storage robustness, QEMU compatibility, and CLI usability.

bio.text: I’m a DevOps and Platform Engineer based in Bengaluru, India. At Amadeus Labs, I work on making development platforms faster, simpler, and more reliable, so that engineers spend their time shipping 🚀 instead of fighting their tooling. Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, and observability are my everyday toolkit, and I like a pipeline that’s boring in the best possible way.

My curiosity doesn’t clock out at 6 PM. I build side projects, break and rebuild things on my homelab just to see what happens, and contribute to open source 💜. Building complex systems is my favorite rabbit hole, and I’ve never come back from one empty-handed.

When I’m not debugging, you’ll find me with a good book 📚, on a football pitch ⚽, or doing laps in a pool 🏊. I also travel ✈️ whenever I can, because the best ideas tend to show up somewhere between a train window and a new city.
This is my little corner of the web for the things I build, the moments I collect, and the books I read. Stick around 😄
